description: Implement the Nurse Database module with all three views (Gallery, Pipeline Kanban, Cohort Table) and the full Nurse Card detail panel. This is the primary module that replaces Notion for nurse tracking.
steps: Create src/pages/NurseDatabase.jsx - the main page component with: (a) a top bar showing 'Nurse Database' title, nurse count, and view toggle buttons (Gallery/Pipeline/Cohort), (b) filter/search controls bar, (c) the active view component. State manages: currentView ('gallery'|'pipeline'|'cohort'), searchQuery, filters (cohort, stage, specialty, readinessStatus, nextAction, flagPresent, efSetLevel, oetStatus, province), sortBy (name, cvScore, yearsExperience, lastContacted, submittedAt), groupBy (specialty, stage, cohort, readinessStatus).

Create src/components/nurses/GalleryView.jsx - default view, Airtable-style photo gallery. Each card renders: circular photo (from photoUrl or initials avatar with #5B2D8E background), full name (bold), CV Score as 1-5 stars (half-stars via filled/half/empty star icons from Lucide), years of experience badge (coloured circle with number), primary specialty badge, city+province with MapPin icon, readiness status badge (grey 'Not Ready' / green 'Placement Ready' / purple 'Placed' / red 'Dropped Out' / yellow 'Deferred'), next action badge (red if overdue, amber if due today, teal if upcoming, grey if no action), flag indicator (red with count if flags > 0). Cards arranged in a responsive CSS grid (min 280px columns). Clicking a card navigates to /nurses/:id. Group-by renders section headers above card groups. Gallery controls at top: Group By dropdown, Sort dropdown, Search input.

Create src/components/nurses/PipelineView.jsx - Kanban board with one column per pipeline stage. Columns scroll horizontally if they overflow. Each column has: stage name header with count badge, and vertically stacked compact cards. Kanban cards show: small circular photo (32px), name, next action badge (colour-coded), readiness status badge, flag count if > 0. Implement drag-and-drop using HTML5 drag API (onDragStart, onDragOver, onDrop) to move cards between columns. On drop, update the nurse's pipelineStage in the store and recalculate readinessStatus. Show a visual drop indicator when dragging over a column. Column order matches PRD Section 7.2: Applied, CV Submitted, CV+English Submitted, Under Review, Shortlisted Yes, Shortlisted Maybe, Not Selected, Didnt Qualify, Selected for Cohort, Reserve, Cohort Confirmed, Training Active, OET Registered, OET Passed, OET Failed, Placement Ready, Placed, Deferred, Dropped Out, Recommended Pathway.

Create src/components/nurses/CohortView.jsx - filtered table view showing only nurses in the selected cohort. Columns: Photo+Name (link to card), Pipeline Stage (badge), Next Action (colour badge), OET Status (badge), OET Scores (W/S/L/R with colour-coded pass/fail), Commitment Fee (badge: Paid green, Pending amber, Overdue red), Agreement Signed (checkbox icon), Flag count, Last Contacted (date). Table rows are clickable to navigate to nurse card. Include a cohort selector dropdown at the top (defaulting to 'Cohort 1').

Create src/pages/NurseCard.jsx - full nurse record page matching PRD Section 7.7. Layout: Card Header (always visible, sticky top) showing: large circular photo, full name (large), preferred name (smaller, brackets), pipeline stage dropdown, NEXT ACTION as the MOST PROMINENT element (large colour badge - red/amber/teal/grey based on urgency, dropdown to change), readiness status badge (auto-calculated), flag count (red icon), last contacted date, cohort tag, submitted at. Below header, tabbed or sectioned scrollable content: (a) Personal Information section with all fields from PRD, (b) Professional Profile section, (c) English Proficiency - EF SET section, (d) English Proficiency - OET section with all score fields, (e) Scorecard section showing all 8 criteria with weights, input fields 1-5, auto-calculated CV Score (stars), Final Score (out of 5.0), and Tier badge, (f) Selection and Pathway section, (g) Cohort and Commitment section, (h) Placement section, (i) Notes/Flags/Source section with rich text area for notes (typing [FLAG] increments flag count), communication log as chronological entries. Each field is editable inline. Changes save to localStorage immediately via the store.

Create src/components/nurses/NurseCardHeader.jsx - extracted header component for the nurse card, making Next Action the visually dominant element (largest text, strongest colour, most prominent position). Use the PRD colour spec: Overdue = Red #EF4444, Due Today = Amber #F59E0B, Upcoming = Teal #0D9488, No action = Grey #9CA3AF.

Create src/components/nurses/ScoreCard.jsx - the scorecard sub-component that displays all 8 criteria in a grid, shows weights (x1, x2, x3), allows 1-5 input per criterion, auto-calculates and displays CV Score (from Hospital Exp + SANC + Qualifications + Specialisation only, as stars), Final Score (all weighted scores / 15), and Tier (4.0-5.0 = Tier 1 Priority, 3.0-3.9 = Tier 1 Standard, 2.0-2.9 = Tier 2 Development, 1.0-1.9 = Tier 3, below 1.0 = Not Suitable).

Create src/components/nurses/CommunicationLog.jsx - chronological log component for the nurse card. Each entry shows: date, channel (Email/LinkedIn/Phone/WhatsApp/In-person/Other), summary text, next action set. Includes an 'Add Entry' form at the top with date picker, channel dropdown, summary textarea, and save button.

Create src/components/shared/Badge.jsx - reusable badge component with variants: status (green/amber/red/grey/purple/yellow), pipeline (matching stage colours), tier (Tier 1 Priority = solid purple, Tier 1 Standard = light purple, Tier 2 = amber, Tier 3 = grey), and custom colour prop.
Create src/components/shared/StarRating.jsx - reusable star rating display (1-5, supports half stars). Uses Star and StarHalf from Lucide.
Create src/components/shared/SearchBar.jsx - search input with magnifying glass icon, debounced onChange (300ms), searches across name, email, SANC number.

Create src/components/shared/FilterPanel.jsx - collapsible filter panel with dropdowns/checkboxes for: Cohort, Pipeline Stage (multi-select), Specialty (multi-select), Readiness Status, Next Action urgency, Flags present (yes/no), EF SET Level, OET Status, Province. Filters apply across all views.

Wire up data flow: NurseDatabase page loads nurses from localStorage store on mount. All views receive filtered/sorted/grouped nurse data as props. Nurse Card page loads single nurse by ID from URL param. Updates to any nurse field trigger store.setNurses() which persists to localStorage. Use React context or prop drilling for the nurse data.

Create src/hooks/useNurses.js - custom hook that provides: nurses (array), loading, updateNurse(id, changes), addNurse(data), getNurseById(id), filteredNurses (based on active filters). Wraps the localStorage store with React state.
Verify: Run npm run build successfully. Navigate through all three views. Open a nurse card and confirm all sections render. Change a Next Action and confirm it persists after page refresh.
acceptance_criteria: Gallery View displays nurse cards with photo/initials, name, stars, badges, location, readiness status, next action badge, and flag count
Gallery View supports group-by (Specialty, Stage, Cohort, Readiness Status), sort-by (Name, CV Score, Years, Last Contacted), and search
Pipeline Kanban shows cards in correct stage columns with all PRD stages represented
Drag-and-drop in Kanban updates pipeline stage and readiness status persists to localStorage
Cohort View table shows OET scores, commitment fee status, agreement signed status filtered by cohort
Nurse Card displays all PRD Section 7.7 fields in organized sections
Next Action is the most visually prominent element on the nurse card with correct urgency colours
Scorecard auto-calculates CV Score, Final Score, and Tier correctly per PRD formulas
Communication Log allows adding new entries with date, channel, and summary
All data changes persist to localStorage and survive page refresh
npm run build completes without errors
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npm run dev' in background, curl localhost:5173 to confirm HTML renders
findings: All components build cleanly. Used exported NurseAvatar and getReadinessVariant from GalleryView for reuse in Pipeline/Cohort views. Tailwind v4 supports arbitrary grid templates via grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))]. No test framework configured yet (Vitest reference in context but no test script in package.json). Used unset NODE_OPTIONS to avoid proxy-bootstrap error.
